snippet.title: Rise Again - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345170/Rise_Again/?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=Trailer&utm_medium=Web&utm_content=Gameplay

Rise Again is an action RPG that combines elements of wizardry, roguelike gameplay, and dungeon crawling. Hack and slash your way through enemies in a medieval fantasy universe, transforming from a forgetful wizard into a skilled dungeon crawler as you progress through the game.

Website: https://www.storyage.net/RiseAgain/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2345170/Rise_Again/?utm_source=Youtube&utm_campaign=Trailer&utm_medium=Web&utm_content=Gameplay
